'''1234''' was a [[B1-series battle droid]] that served in the [[Trade Federation]] [[Trade Federation Droid Army|Droid Army]]. During the [[Invasion of Naboo|Naboo Crisis]], 1234 fought against the [[Gungan Grand Army]] at the [[Great Grass Plains]], but the [[battle droid]] was destroyed by [[Bombad General]] [[Jar Jar Binks]].<ref name="tpm" />

The B1's designation was written on the back of his [[comlink booster pack]].<ref name="tpm" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
1234 first appeared in the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], the first installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]]. While the [[droid]]'s designation can be spotted in film,<ref name="tpm" /> the numbers could not be identified until ''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' gave a translation for B1 numerals.<ref name="Complete Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]''</ref>
